title: Structures, Classes, Enumerations, and Properties
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of structures, classes, enumerations, and properties in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 8: Structures, Classes, Enumerations, and Properties. Lessons in order: Introduction to Custom Types; Structures in Swift; Structure Methods; Initializers; Initializer Design; Computed Properties; Property Observers; Type Properties and Methods; Enumerations; Associated Values and Recursive Enums; Classes and Reference Types; Inheritance and Method Dispatch; Extensions and Access Control.
